---
title: Using Duckdb WASM in Quarto
---

The version of DuckDB deployed in Quarto ojs cells is very old:
```{ojs}
db = await DuckDBClient.of();
Inputs.table(db.query("select version() as version;"));
```


Import the current version directly from jsdelivr:
```{ojs}
duckdb = import("https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@duckdb/duckdb-wasm/+esm")
duckdb.PACKAGE_VERSION
```

Instantiate a database instance:
```{ojs}
bundles = duckdb.getJsDelivrBundles();
bundle = duckdb.selectBundle(bundles);
async function makeDB() {
  const logger = new duckdb.ConsoleLogger();
  const worker = await duckdb.createWorker(bundle.mainWorker);
  const db = new duckdb.AsyncDuckDB(logger, worker);
  await db.instantiate(bundle.mainModule);
  return db
}
db2 = makeDB();
db2.getVersion();
```

```{ojs}
result = {
    const cn = await db2.connect();
    const result = cn.query('select version() as version');
    await cn.close();
    return result;
}
Inputs.table(result);
```

```{ojs}
cn = {
    const cn = await db2.connect();
    cn.query("CREATE TABLE test (a INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, b VARCHAR)");
    cn.query("INSERT INTO test VALUES (1, 'test1');")
    return cn;
}
```

```{ojs}
result3 = {
    const result = cn.query("select * from test");
    return result
}
Inputs.table(result3);
```


```{ojs}
cn2 = {
    const cn = await db2.connect();
    cn.query("install httpfs;");
    cn.query("load httpfs;");
    cn.query("CREATE VIEW node AS SELECT * FROM read_parquet('https://storage.googleapis.com/opencontext-parquet/oc_isamples_pqg.parquet')");
    return cn;
}
```

```{ojs}
Inputs.table(cn2.query("select count(*) as n from node;"));
```

```{ojs}
Inputs.table(cn2.query("SELECT pid, latitude, longitude FROM node WHERE latitude IS NOT NULL AND longitude IS NOT NULL LIMIT 100;"));
```
